rules.title: General wealth question: scope and querent

source_locator.passage_anchor: Whoever interrogates; if the Question be in generall termes
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ascendant, its lord and Moon signify the asker regardless of rank. The opening method concerns whether the asker will ever be rich, without reference to a particular person from whom a fortune is expected.
qualifications_and_limits: A horary question, not a natal wealth rule or a claim about an actual person's finances.

rules.title: Wealth significators and their configurations

source_locator.passage_anchor: Consider the Signe ascending on the Cusp of the second House
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

source_statement: planets aspecting second lord or cusp
qualifications_and_limits: Inventory is not a numerical weighting or precedence algorithm.

rules.title: Fortune and the nodes do not emit rays

source_locator.passage_anchor: for Fortune it selfe emitteth no rayes
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Fortune itself casts no aspect to a planet; neither do the north and south nodes.
qualifications_and_limits: Receiving a planetary aspect is distinct from emitting one. Do not symmetrize these semantic roles merely because longitude geometry is symmetric.

rules.title: All planets angular: general wealth testimony

source_locator.passage_anchor: if you find the Planets all angular
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: All planets angular are one good sign of substance.
qualifications_and_limits: The author calls the opening rules general. This is one testimony, not an unconditional calibrated verdict.

rules.title: Succedent direct swift planets

source_locator.passage_anchor: if they be in succedant houses, direct and swift
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Planets in succedent houses, direct and swift, are a favourable general testimony.

rules.title: Good houses and moderate essential dignity

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Planets be in good houses
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Planets in good houses, direct and moderately essentially dignified, give hope of an estate.
qualifications_and_limits: No local exhaustive definition of good houses or numerical minimum for moderate dignity.

rules.title: Union of querent and wealth significators

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon, and Lord of the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The opening favourable alternatives include bodily joining of the Ascendant lord or Moon with the second lord.
qualifications_and_limits: The printed coordination is not a formal Boolean expression. Preserve uncertainty over its exact grouping; do not require or exclude a three-body conjunction silently.

rules.title: Friendly aspect to the second lord

source_locator.passage_anchor: or if they, viz. Lord of the Ascendant and Moon
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Friendly aspect from the Ascendant lord and Moon to the second lord is another favourable alternative.
qualifications_and_limits: The source names both in this clause; do not silently replace and by or. Friendly is not given a new orb here.

rules.title: Jupiter or Venus contacting Fortune

source_locator.passage_anchor: or if Jupiter and Venus cast their trine or sextile
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Jupiter and Venus casting trine or sextile to Fortune, or being conjunct it, supply favourable testimony.
qualifications_and_limits: The enumerative wording does not settle whether both benefics must act in every application.

rules.title: Wealth lord in the first

source_locator.passage_anchor: or if the Lord of the second be in the Ascendant
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The second lord in the Ascendant is a favourable wealth testimony.

rules.title: Querent significator in the second

source_locator.passage_anchor: or the Moon, or Lord of the Ascendant in the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Moon or Ascendant lord in the second is favourable wealth testimony.

rules.title: Translation from wealth lord to querent lord

source_locator.passage_anchor: if any Planet transfer the light and vertue
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A planet translating the second lord's light and virtue to the Ascendant lord supplies favourable wealth testimony.
qualifications_and_limits: Direction is retained. The local clause does not restate every prior translation prerequisite.

rules.title: Benefic rays to Ascendant cusp or Fortune

source_locator.passage_anchor: benevolent Planets cast their sextile or trine
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Benevolent planets casting sextile or trine to the Ascendant cusp or Fortune are favourable.

rules.title: Jupiter-Venus nature fixed stars

source_locator.passage_anchor: any fixed Starre of the nature of Jupiter and Venus
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A fixed star of Jupiter/Venus nature ascending with the second cusp, or Fortune conjunct or near such a star, is favourable.
qualifications_and_limits: No list of stars or numerical near/rising threshold is supplied locally.

rules.title: Second-house natural benefics and north node

source_locator.passage_anchor: Jupiter who is naturall significator of substance
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Jupiter, naturally signifying substance, Venus, naturally a fortune, or the north node in the second is favourable when no infortune aspects them.
qualifications_and_limits: The no-infortune qualification belongs to the clause; node is not misread as a planet.

rules.title: Direct swift motion defined against mean

source_locator.passage_anchor: their daily motion be more then what is assigned
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: All planets direct and swift are favourable; swift means daily motion greater than the assigned mean motion.
qualifications_and_limits: Strictly greater, not greater-or-equal. Printed references are pages57,61,65,69,72,76,80. Retain source means instead of silently using a modern ephemeris average.

rules.title: Judgement magnitude and social capacity

source_locator.passage_anchor: competently rich or have a sufficient fortune to subsist on
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The favourable testimonies indicate competent wealth or sufficient subsistence, with greater or lesser estate according to the major relevant testimonies and the capacity/condition of the person asking.
qualifications_and_limits: No fixed currency threshold, probability, uniform definition of rich, or numerical majority/weighting formula is supplied.

rules.title: Means-of-wealth enquiry is conditional

source_locator.passage_anchor: When you have sufficiently examined your Figure
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Only after judging that subsistence or riches are promised does the discussion ask how, by whom and by what means they are obtained.
qualifications_and_limits: A listed house association is not itself proof that wealth is promised.

rules.title: Second lord's placement: labour or unexpected acquisition

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the second house be in the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

source_statement.second_lord_in_first: unexpected fortune or attainment without much labour

rules.title: Trace the helping aspect before choosing a means

source_locator.passage_anchor: If that the Lord of the second or the Moon doe promise substance
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: When second lord or Moon promises substance through their mutual aspect, inspect the house from which the aspect comes or the house ruled by the Moon. If neither promises substance, inspect Fortune's house and its dispositor's house lordship.
qualifications_and_limits: These are conditional alternatives, not an instruction to collect every possible house narrative.

rules.title: Helpful first lord: own work

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Planet assisting or promising encrease of Fortune be Lord of the Ascendant
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A helping Ascendant lord signifies the asker's diligence advancing the estate; for an ordinary artisan, labour, invention, care and pains-taking.
prerequisites: The planet actually assists or promises increase.

rules.title: Helpful second lord: existing capital and commerce

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Adjuvant Planet be Lord of the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A helping second lord signifies increasing and managing one's own stock; buying and selling things to which the person is naturally inclined, which arise in the course of life, or which suit the planet's nature, with its sign considered.
prerequisites: The planet actually assists or promises increase.

rules.title: Helpful third lord: kin, neighbours and journeys

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the third fortunate the Lord of the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Third lord helping second lord, second cusp or Fortune indicates aid through an honest neighbour, kin, siblings if present, a journey, or removal toward the quarter from which the helpful aspect or conjunction comes.
qualifications_and_limits: Siblings are explicitly conditional on having them; the alternatives are not separate independent predictions.

rules.title: Helpful fourth-house connection

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the fortunate Planet or Significator be Lord of the fourth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A fortunate significator ruling or occupying the fourth indicates aid from a living father, grandfather or other older person; farms, land, buildings, inherited stock, or money lent by kin.
qualifications_and_limits: Living father is an explicit condition; occupation and lordship are alternative predicates.

rules.title: Helpful fifth lord: social-role alternatives

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the fifth doe promise Wealth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

source_statement.gentleman: play, cards, dice, sports or pastimes
source_statement.ordinary_person: victualling house, inn, tavern, bowling alley, doorkeeper or porter
source_statement.strong_fifth_lord_any_querent: something from father's estate or making matches

qualifications_and_limits: Historical alternatives, not present recommendations or a replacement of the fourth-house inheritance association.

rules.title: Sixth and a human sign: service and labour

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the sixth, or Significator, or assistant Planet be in the sixth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The sixth lord, significator or helping planet being in the sixth, with a human sign on the sixth, indicates good servants and profit from their labour; for a king/prince the continuation describes subjects' subsidies and loans.
qualifications_and_limits: Grammar leaves the exact scope of the human-sign and occupancy qualifications across the following occupational examples unresolved.

rules.title: Sixth-house occupational alternatives

source_locator.passage_anchor: If a Nobleman or Gentleman enquire
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

source_statement.nobleman_or_gentleman: leases and discreet estate management by stewards or bailiffs
source_statement.farmer: small cattle including sheep, goats, hogs and rabbits

prerequisites: Continues the preceding sixth-house source branch.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical occupational symbolism; no medical-care or career recommendation is admitted.

rules.title: Helpful seventh lord: partner, disputes and commerce

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the seventh house fortunate the Lord of the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Seventh lord helping second lord, cusp, Fortune or second-house occupant points to a rich/good wife or a helpful woman; for a gentleman, war, legal recovery or bargains; for a merchant, ordinary trade acquaintances.
qualifications_and_limits: Preserve role-conditioned alternatives; marriage is one possible channel, not an obligatory means for every case.

rules.title: Helpful eighth lord: inheritance, portion, unexpected residence

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the eighth be that Planet who fortunates
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A helping eighth lord points to a bequest, an unexpected increase in a wife's portion, or voluntary residence in an unplanned country where substance increases.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not turn the source association into a forecast of someone's death.

rules.title: Helpful ninth lord: sea and personal intermediaries

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the ninth give vertue or fortunate
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ninth lord helping Fortune, second lord or cusp may signify a sea voyage when Cancer or Pisces is on the ninth cusp and its lord is there; other named channels are the wife's brothers/allies, a neighbour near her former home, or a religious person helping the vocation.
qualifications_and_limits: Original sign glyphs are Cancer and Pisces. Scope of the aquatic condition over the later personal alternatives is not formally specified.

rules.title: Earthy ninth sign and its lord therein

source_locator.passage_anchor: If an Earthly Signe be on the cusp of the ninth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: An earthy ninth-cusp sign with its lord there points to moving toward the sign/quarter and trading the destination's native commodities.

rules.title: Tenth-house wealth predicates

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the second be fortunate in the tenth house
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Second lord fortunate in tenth, reception between tenth and second lords, or tenth lord's benevolent configuration to second lord/cusp/occupant/Fortune signifies gain through service or employment by a superior.
qualifications_and_limits: Reception, occupation and aspect are alternative source predicates; no automatic employer-wealth frame is inferred from this general means-of-gain paragraph.

rules.title: Tenth-house capacity qualifications

source_locator.passage_anchor: if one inquires that is young and of small fortune
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A young person of small means is assigned a mechanical trade fitting tenth sign and lord, if capable and fit; an educated person seeking advancement is assigned an office or public employment.
qualifications_and_limits: The capacity and preference inputs are explicit; this is historical source content, not career advice.

rules.title: Helpful eleventh lord: recommendation and unexpected opportunity

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the eleventh be that benevolent Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A benevolent eleventh lord acting as the helping significator points to a friend's recommendation, merchant/courtier or servant of a great person, and unexpected advantageous employment or fortune.

rules.title: Helpful planet in the twelfth: sign-conditioned channels

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Fortunate Planet who casts his Aspect as aforesaid be in the twelfth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

prerequisites: The planet is actually fortunate/helping as previously described.
qualifications_and_limits: The author adds that judgement must be mixed with reason. Virgo's grain clause must not be merged into the three cattle signs.

rules.title: Author's strongest lasting-wealth configuration

source_locator.passage_anchor: The most assured testimony in Astrology, and upon a Question onely propounded
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Lilly calls first lord, second lord and Jupiter together in second, first, tenth, seventh, fourth or eleventh the strongest testimony that a querent will be rich and remain so. If not conjunct, he gives application by sextile/trine with mutual reception; square/opposition with reception may still produce an estate through labour and intervening difficulty, with abundance rather than want.
qualifications_and_limits: Author's assurance claim, not measured accuracy. The three-body aspect/reception topology and whether the listed houses constrain all alternatives are not formalized locally.

rules.title: Obstruction analysis follows an adverse wealth judgement

source_locator.passage_anchor: When in any Question you find your Figure signifies the querent shall come to an estate
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The following obstruction analysis is unnecessary when wealth is already judged; it applies when no great fortune is shown and the asker wants the reason or impediment.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not combine opposite applicability branches into simultaneous supportive explanations.

rules.title: Find the main obstructing planet

source_locator.passage_anchor: carefully observe the Planet obstructing
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Inspect the planet most afflicting second lord, Fortune, second cusp, Moon, or Fortune's lord/dispositor.
qualifications_and_limits: No complete severity metric or tie-breaker for most afflicting.

rules.title: Obstructing first lord

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the first be that Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: If the first lord is the obstructing planet, Lilly assigns the cause to the querent.
prerequisites: Adverse wealth judgement and that planet is the actual obstructer.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical attribution, not evidence of blame or psychological fact.

rules.title: Obstructing second lord

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the second doe with square or opposition behold
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Second lord square/opposite Fortune or the second cusp indicates lack of money or stock to establish employment.

rules.title: Obstructing third lord and continuation through houses

source_locator.passage_anchor: if Lord of the third, his own Kindred will doe nothing for him
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Third-lord obstruction is assigned to unhelpful/burdensome kin or neighbours taking trade or under-selling; the author instructs analogous interpretation through all twelve houses.
qualifications_and_limits: Only the first three causes are exemplified here. Do not invent nine additional verbatim source rows.

rules.title: Malefics can help acquisition

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the second house, or Dispositor of Fortune be Infortunes
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Malefic second lord or Fortune dispositor may signify acquisition when essentially dignified, aspecting good planets, or occupying benevolent houses.
qualifications_and_limits: Natural malefic identity alone does not determine the financial testimony.

rules.title: Benefics can obstruct acquisition

source_locator.passage_anchor: both Jupiter and Venus being afflicted or impedited
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Jupiter and Venus may obstruct when afflicted, impeded or assigned as the obstructing significators.
qualifications_and_limits: Role, condition and natural character remain separate; no universal positive Jupiter/Venus score.

rules.title: South node's house-specific impediment

source_locator.passage_anchor: in what House you find Cauda Draconis
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The south node is assigned detriment in the topics of its house: in second, estate consumption by folly/neglect; in third, difficulty through kin; analogize through other houses.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical source symbolism, not a supported claim about present people.

rules.title: Ordinary recovery/borrowing/pledge frame

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Querent shall obtaine the Substance which he demands
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

prerequisites: Recovery, borrowing or pledged goods from the particular other party; ordinary comparable parties, qualified onPDF208.
qualifications_and_limits: The eighth is the second counted inclusively from seventh. Powerful superior uses another frame.

rules.title: Ordinary recovery through eighth-house contact

source_locator.passage_anchor: See if the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon be joyned
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ascendant lord or Moon joining eighth lord, or joining/aspecting an eighth-house planet, may obtain desired money, loan or restored pledge when the planet is a fortune or the aspect fortunate; a fortunate eighth-house planet need not be received.
qualifications_and_limits: Keep the source's conjunction/aspect and reception alternatives; this is not a generic rule that any eighth-house contact succeeds.

rules.title: Ordinary recovery through a malefic receiving the querent

source_locator.passage_anchor: if an infortunate Planet be in the eighth, or Lord of the eighth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A malefic in or ruling eighth that receives Ascendant lord or Moon can give the desired recovery. Without reception the source predicts hardly ever obtaining it, or such labour that the requester regrets it.
qualifications_and_limits: Hardly ever / if ever is not rewritten as an absolute impossibility; reception direction is material.

rules.title: Eighth lord enters first/second with second-lord reception

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the eighth be in the first, or in the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Eighth lord in first or second, received by second lord, makes accomplishment probable.
qualifications_and_limits: Source says probable; no numerical probability and no reception reversal.

rules.title: Other-party lords in first/second without reception

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the seventh, or of the eighth be in the first or second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Seventh or eighth lord in first or second with no reception involving first lord, second lord or Moon indicates denial or further prejudice.
qualifications_and_limits: The phrase have reception of does not unambiguously formalize reception direction; retain rather than silently substitute a direction.

rules.title: Joining a benefic dignified in Ascendant signs

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon be joyned to a Fortune
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ascendant lord and Moon joining a fortune with dignity in the rising sign or a sign intercepted in the Ascendant effects the matter.
qualifications_and_limits: Source names both in this clause; intercepted sign is retained.

rules.title: Joining an Ascendant-dignified malefic with reception

source_locator.passage_anchor: if any of them be joyned to an Infortune
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Either querent significator joining a malefic with Ascendant dignity succeeds if that malefic receives Ascendant lord or Moon.
qualifications_and_limits: Reception and dignity are two requirements, not one favourable keyword.

rules.title: Well-placed fortune in tenth or eleventh

source_locator.passage_anchor: Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon be joyned to a fortunate Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ascendant lord or Moon joining a fortunate planet well placed in tenth or eleventh effects the matter even without reception.
qualifications_and_limits: This does not erase reception requirements of the separate malefic branches.

rules.title: Ordinary-party rule excludes powerful debtors

source_locator.passage_anchor: The Judgments of this Chapter shall then have place
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: The immediately preceding recovery rules concern ordinary comparable parties such as citizen with citizen or tradesman with tradesman. Lilly exempts kings, princes and nobles who pay slowly and are little constrained by law.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical scope statement; no new modern social-rank classifier or categorical legal claim is inferred.

rules.title: Superior payment frame

source_locator.passage_anchor: If one shall acquire that Gain or Profit, Wages or Stipend
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

prerequisites: The asker is much inferior to the person from whom payment/accomplishment is expected.
qualifications_and_limits: The eleventh is the second counted inclusively from tenth. The rule applies to the declared relationship, not any preferred result.

rules.title: Unimpeded eleventh-house benefic and payment

source_locator.passage_anchor: Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon joyned to the Lord of the eleventh
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Ascendant lord or Moon joining eleventh lord, or an eleventh-house planet that is a fortune unimpeded and not ill disposed, signifies obtaining salary, debt or wages owed by the great person.
qualifications_and_limits: Keep the original distinction between the lord clause and the qualified occupant clause; exact scope of the final qualification is a parsing uncertainty.

rules.title: Malefic receiving querent significators in superior-payment enquiry

source_locator.passage_anchor: Moon and Lord of the Ascendant be joyned to an unfortunate Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Moon and Ascendant lord joining a malefic that receives them into its essential dignities signify payment after much solicitation, weary approaches, fear and distrust.
qualifications_and_limits: Joining, reception, and named querent significators are preserved. The difficult path is separate from whether payment occurs.

rules.title: Unreceived malefic in superior-payment enquiry

source_locator.passage_anchor: any Aspect be betwixt the Significators
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: An aspect between significators where one is a malefic and reception absent signifies not obtaining the desire.
qualifications_and_limits: Unlike the ordinary recovery clause, this passage is categorical. Do not flatten the two into one outcome rule.

rules.title: Reception type must be identified

source_locator.passage_anchor: be very carefull to observe the Planets true essentiall dignities
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Observe true essential dignities and mutual receptions, including which dignity receives the other significator.
qualifications_and_limits: Reception is not a single undifferentiated boolean for every downstream rule.

rules.title: Timing requires the actual effective significator

source_locator.passage_anchor: unto what Planet either the Lord of the Ascendant or Moon applyes
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Choose the planet to which Ascendant lord or Moon applies or bodily joins and which signifies accomplishment; in a sextile/trine case, whether that planet is a benefic or not, and whether it receives the Ascendant lord or Moon or not, inspect the rays through perfection or the degrees lacking to exact aspect/conjunction at the question.
qualifications_and_limits: Time-to-contact astronomy and symbolic distance-to-time are distinct. Static distance does not compute a moving contact date.

rules.title: Second-house timing units by both houses

source_locator.passage_anchor: so many dayes; if they be both in Cadent houses
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

prerequisites: Both selected significators and their houses known; degrees remaining to the relevant perfection.
qualifications_and_limits: These local units are not the sign-modality news scale or a universal Lilly timing rule. Fractional unit/calendar conventions are not defined.

rules.source_statement: A significator joined to an unimpeded benefic planet perfects the matter.

rules.title: Afflicted collector must receive both significators

rules.title: Persistence synthesis with limited meaning of rich

source_locator.passage_anchor: Entire paragraph under If the Querent should continue Rich
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: A fixed second cusp with Fortune in it, exalted angular Jupiter, and Venus as Mars's dispositor plus Moon in fixed Leo lead Lilly to judge a lasting plentiful estate; he explains this as continued competent fortune without poverty or want.
qualifications_and_limits: The historical judgment does not establish lifelong observed persistence.
Rich is explicitly narrowed to continued competence, not limitless increase.

qualifications_and_limits: Do not impose exact equality on the contra-antiscion example: Saturn Cancer14d41m is2d50m from Jupiter Cancer17d31m.

rules.title: Saturn contra-antiscion: kinship and servant cautions

source_locator.passage_anchor: From whence I judged no great unity through tincture of Saturn with Jupiter
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

rules.source_statement: Saturn physically in the third and its contra-antiscion disturbing Jupiter, the third lord, lead Lilly to judge poor unity with kin, brothers and sisters; he also reads harm from servants or blemishes in their behavior, despite Jupiter's exaltation.
qualifications_and_limits: These are source judgments and cautions, not stated observed outcomes.
The sixth cusp Pisces supplies a possible shared Jupiter lordship in the chart, but this explanatory bridge is not explicitly stated in the prose.
Historical moralized character language is not a modern diagnosis.

rules.title: Sun affliction and caution about solar friends

source_locator.passage_anchor: Here are onely two things through see page71

rules.source_statement: Sun as eleventh lord squares Fortune sinister and also the second cusp; Lilly says he warned against commitments to or confidence in solar men even if friends. He tells the reader to describe the afflicting planet and refers to printed71 for solar men.
qualifications_and_limits: A historical caution, not modern financial advice.
Preserve the friendship qualification; the earlier friend-help prediction is not retracted for every friend.
The paragraph says two things without an unambiguous numbered pair; do not invent two independently confirmed warnings.
